feedback: Accepted. The machine faithfully encodes both clauses of the task. u0 is the initial carrying state; falls are consumed as event edges (u0->u1, u2->u3), and u1/u3 allow exactly one step of grace: holding_box & !at_exit there is the compliant pickup (sound, because a fall empties the hands and only a pickup can refill them, and a pickup can never share the terminal exit step), while !holding_box drops into the absorbing failure sink u4 with -0.5, so missing the very next move is fatal, as required. Success u5 requires at_exit & holding_box and is reachable (u0->u1->u2->u5, and via the second fall u2->u3->u2->u5); the u2->u3->u2 cycle matches the two-fall schedule, and later pickups, which cause no fall, are correctly absorbed by u2's else self-loop. A voluntary drop after the first fall is not a task violation and is correctly neutral in u2; exiting with empty hands from any live state pays -0.5, and u4 blocking later success is right because a missed immediate pickup is an irremovable violation. All six states are reachable (u3 in episodes with a second fall), so there are no dead states. Irrelevant events (siren_ringing, switch_toggled) never appear in any guard and are absorbed by per-state else self-loops (u0, u2, u4, u5) and by the partition guards of u1/u3, so a ring or a switch toggle can neither shield a missed pickup nor cause a spurious transition. Rewards are bounded and unfarmable: re-entering u1/u3 requires a genuine box_fell edge and there are at most two falls, so the +0.1 pickup shaping cannot be repeated beyond that (only the first pickup earns it as written); at most one +1.0 in absorbing u5 and one -0.5 into absorbing u4; the exogenous fall itself correctly earns 0. Format matches the paper template exactly, and FINAL_STATES is nonempty, declaring the declared, accepting success state u5 (u4 is correctly the non-final rejecting sink). Minor, non-blocking notes: (1) the compliant pickup out of u3 earns 0 while the symmetric u1 pickup earns 0.1; adding (u3, holding_box & !at_exit, u2) -> 0.1, or removing the u1 reward, would make the shaping consistent - the constraint itself is still fully enforced structurally, since a miss still costs -0.5 and closes the success path. (2) A few defensively unreachable transitions exist: the two u0 exit transitions (the first fall always fires by step 8 while the exit needs at least 10 moves from the start corner, so u0 never sees at_exit) and the at_exit & holding_box transitions of u1/u3 (hands are empty there); the else self-loops of u1/u3 are also shadowed because guards 2 and 3 partition the label space. All of these are harmless and semantically correct if ever taken; they could be pruned for compactness.

All five environment-declared propositions are implemented exactly once, with no extras and none missing. siren_ringing matches the documented expression env.siren_ringing (persistent condition, current state). switch_toggled and box_fell are event propositions correctly derived from env.events_this_step ('toggle' and 'fall' respectively), true only on the step the event fires. holding_box matches the documented guard env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == 'box', true at the first step since the agent starts carrying. at_exit matches the documented expression with the required cell is not None guard before reading .type, evaluated at the agent's current position. Only documented API members are used (env.siren_ringing, env.events_this_step, env.carrying.type, env.agent_pos, env.grid.get); no imports, no object classes, no mutation of env or episode_memory, no side effects, and all functions are syntactically valid read-only Python returning booleans.
